- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Airbus is utilizing 3D printing to design and produce aircraft parts, offering greater design flexibility and reducing production time and cost.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Airbus developed an innovative winglet design known as Sharklets, which improves fuel efficiency and reduces CO2 emissions.
